Name: Prettier Bus Stop
Author: Kanadeyoru
Description:
There's not much to say, this mod makes the bus stop map a bit more fancy xD

Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village.

[b]!!! If you are using Adventurer's Guild Expanded for 1.6 move the monster basement’s entrance to 16, 20 (There's an option for that on the Adventurer's Guild Expanded for 1.6 configuration file)[/b]
